_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgEV9LRY8FfTWS7J6T3MwsSL)_

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：只改元数据参考文档里「页头按钮露几个」的说明文字，界面行为不变。
- 属于记录页一行头部专题的收尾，让文档与上一张卡改过的默认值一致。
- 只是说明文字，出错只会让作者读到不准的说明，可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, `page:header`:

- `maxVisible` describe: "(renderer default 3)" becomes "Renderer default when unset: 1 in a record page's one-row header bar, 3 on any other header."
- `mobileMaxVisible` describe: "(renderer default 1)" becomes "Renderer default when unset: 2 in a record page's bottom action bar on a phone, 1 on any other header."
- The docblock above them no longer names 3 / 1 as the fallbacks; it points at the describe strings. Its reason for having no schema default is unchanged.
- `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` regenerated with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:docs` (2 rows).
- Changeset `35660-page-header-max-visible-describe.md`, `patch` on `@objectstack/spec`.
- `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx:303` (hand-written, claim surface amendment 2, comment 7036602364): the Default cell of the `maxVisible` / `mobileMaxVisible` row said "3 / 1"; it now states the same per-host fallbacks. The docs-drift bot flagged it (comment 7036588828). The release-owned pages it also names are untouched.

No schema shape change, no `.default()`, no renderer code.

## Tests

<details><summary>Renderer fallbacks measured at origin/main 65fddc84 (A1)</summary>

All in `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`, the one resolver `PageHeaderActions`:

- `:2603-2607`: bar face uses `mobileMaxVisible ?? PHONE_ACTION_BAR_BUTTONS`; mobile row uses `mobileMaxVisible ?? 1`; desktop uses `maxVisible ?? defaultMaxVisible ?? 3`.
- `:1929`: `PHONE_ACTION_BAR_BUTTONS = 2`.
- `:3153`: `page:header` passes `defaultMaxVisible={inBar ? 1 : undefined}`; `inBar` is true only at `:3492`, the record page's one-row header bar (`drawsInBar`, `:3168`). The in-page record header (`:3547`) and the non-record header (`:3570`) pass nothing, so 3.
- `:3149`: `face="bar"` when the host gives a phone face (the record page's bottom action bar).
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:5775`: the print chrome draws `PageHeaderActions` with no budget props (3 / 1), but that row has no `page:header`, so the keys do not reach it.

</details>

<details><summary>Generated artifacts (A2) and gates, local, head 3af57151; pages.mdx commit 263001fa re-ran affected-docs, drift-comment, doc-anchors, doc-authoring, docs-spec-enumerations, nul-bytes, all exit 0</summary>

- `git grep` of both old strings: only `component.zod.ts` and `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date" (exit 0).
- exit 0: `check:docs`, `check:liveness`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:api-surface`, `check:llms-txt` (spec); `check:adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `check-issue-citations`, `docs-audit/check-affected-docs`, `docs-audit/check-drift-comment`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:docs-spec-enumerations`, `check-nul-bytes`.
- `overlap-check --branch=HEAD`: VERDICT clean.
- The rest of the derived families run in CI.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, not edited (outside the claim's file surface): the renderer comment at `containers.tsx:2574` ("default to 3 / 1"), the prop docs at `containers.tsx:1947/1949`, `ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts:1072` "(default: 1)" and `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/auto-trigger.ts:24` still state the old pair. They are code comments, no metadata or author-facing reference; carrier: none.

## Verification

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:docs && git diff content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` shows no change: the two `page:header` rows read as above.
